author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-030 source-review author agent (first-run)

prerequisites: Fresh unseeded labs built by scripts/documentation/lab.mjs from 067c1646 with application digest 34696f76..., each with its own Mailpit. openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-firstrun2 ran the full path to Finish in one lifecycle. openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-firstrun3 ran three lifecycles (Skip optional steps; Set up later on Review; Finish without Start blank). openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-firstrun4 re-walked the corrected step 3. All used the same app and engine image IDs.
The fictional first Administrator is Avery Morgan (avery.morgan@harbor.example). The setup token was read from each lab's .env at run time.
Email phases on firstrun2 recreated only app and worker with SMTP_URL set and SMTP_FROM empty (before the first account and after completion) or with both empty (for the relay form).
A local OpenID Connect stand-in (oauth2-mock-server 9.2.0) on the firstrun2 backend network served Register provider as http://oidc:8080.
Start blank's in-use refusal used one Matter created, then re-typed to the Default type, through the Administrator's own session as fixture setup.
The browser ran inside a pasta network namespace; Chromium mapped the name localhost to 127.0.0.1 for the wrong-origin check.
scenarios.expected: The Administrator reaches the app and the saved settings reflect the completed steps. Outbound email is required, and the wizard cannot finish until a relay is saved or the environment sets one. Validation and retry work, resumed onboarding works, Finish is refused while outbound email is not configured, and the Setup checklist and Review behave as the article states.
scenarios.actual: 71 recorded steps passed in the final runs. Set up OpenLaw from localhost showed "This request did not come from this OpenLaw instance's own origin." An empty Setup token was stopped by the browser ("Please fill out this field.") with no request sent; a wrong token showed "The setup token is missing or wrong. Copy it from the server log, or from SETUP_TOKEN."; a seven-character password was refused; different passwords showed "The passwords do not match." The corrected form opened Welcome to OpenLaw, Step 1 of 9, and setup then redirected to Sign in with a 409. With SMTP_URL but no SMTP_FROM, Home, Settings, Matters and /settings/email opened the wizard at Welcome; Skip optional steps opened Outbound email with the SMTP_FROM warning, no Set up later and Continue disabled; Finish and Set up later on Review opened Outbound email and the completion API answered 409. With email unset, every page opened the wizard. Your organization offered only English (United States), refused a GIF and a PNG over 5 MB with the logo message, and on Continue refused a 4100 x 4000 PNG with "The logo must be a readable PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG with no more than 16 million pixels." Set up later saved nothing; Continue saved name, logo and Europe/Lisbon; Sign in then showed the name and logo. Reload kept the step from ?step= and dropped an unsaved name. Authentication refused no method ("Enable at least one sign-in method."); Single sign-on (SSO) stayed unavailable until Register provider showed "Identity provider harbor-idp is registered." and the callback URL; Require two-factor authentication sent Continue to /auth/two-factor/enroll, and Done after a TOTP code opened Welcome with saved choices kept. Business-user portal saved helix.example and harbor.example and the magic-link switch, and did not save an entry with an email username. Outbound email required SMTP username and SMTP password for Username and password, refused a URL as SMTP server, then Save relay showed "Relay saved. The next email this instance sends will use it.", enabled Continue with no Set up later, and Send test email delivered "OpenLaw test email". Its header showed Harbor Legal DOC-030 and the organization logo (inline org-logo@openlaw, 48 x 48 PNG), and so did the "Set your OpenLaw password" invitation to Rowan Lee. Mid-way the Setup checklist listed Invite your team, E-signature, AI analysis and Review seeded types (Mark as reviewed, no link). Send invite sent Legal team member and Administrator invitations; an unsent entry was not delivered. E-signature and AI analysis Set up later left both connectors unconfigured. Review listed 11 lists with counts (including Director & Officer roles and separate Matter, Contract and Entity fields rows) plus Reminder offsets, recommended keeping the seeds, and list links opened Settings with Return to setup back to Review. The Start blank dialog named 8 lists with row counts; with a seeded Matter type in use it showed "Matter types has 1 seeded row in use. Move those records first, or keep the seeded lists." and removed nothing. After the record moved, Start blank closed the dialog and showed "Seeded rows removed. The counts below are current." with onboarding not complete; it kept Other and Default types, Open and Closed, Draft, Active and Expired, all 3 Fields and offsets [7,1,0], left Review, Approval and Signature Stages empty and Open alone in the Open Category, removed Review seeded types from the checklist, and wrote 8 audit entries naming each list and count. A type added in Settings (no delete control) made Start blank refuse with "Matter types already holds 1 row you added. Remove them first, or keep the seeded lists." Finish in a second tab opened Home, and Start blank then showed "Instance setup is complete. Manage each list in Settings." The wizard could not be reopened; the header showed the name and logo; Settings kept the saved values and listed the invited users; Settings -> Advanced -> Outbound email managed the app-saved relay. After completion with SMTP_FROM removed, the checklist's Email row opened /settings/email. On firstrun3, Skip optional steps and Set up later on Review each ended onboarding without the review, Mark as reviewed then removed Review seeded types, an environment relay made Outbound email read-only with Continue available, and Finish without Start blank recorded the review.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical reviewer. It is not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
Single sign-on was checked only as far as Register provider, the callback URL and the SSO switch, against a local OpenID Connect stand-in. No SSO sign-in was run.
E-signature and AI analysis were only skipped; connecting them belongs to the connector guides.
The Email row of the Setup checklist shows only after completion, because before completion an unconfigured email sends every page to the wizard. It was seen by removing SMTP_FROM after completion.
The guide gives no steps for moving a record that blocks Start blank. The walkthrough created and re-typed the blocking Matter through the Administrator's session as fixture setup.
The onboarding-complete refusal was produced by selecting Finish in a second tab while the Start blank dialog was open, the race the guide describes.
Invitation activation and Business User entry, which the article leaves to later checks, were not exercised.

Runs 1 to 13 walked guide 175f145d; the author then changed only the step 3 sentence about the token message, and run 14 on a fresh lab re-walked steps 1 to 3 against ef145063. Superseded development runs 0, 7 and 9 changed no state and are marked in walkthrough.json.

Product bugs seen, not guide errors: the Start blank dialog's Kept line omits the Default type it keeps; the user-added-row refusal says Remove them first although Settings has no delete control; the audit entry names officer roles where the interface says Director & Officer roles.
